_doc: tools/import_hug_guns.gd reads this: every <kind>_<tier>.png here (the gun alone, horizontal, muzzle RIGHT, no hand grips, flat backdrop: green or magenta, the corners' colour) → assets/weapons/<kind>/hug_<tier>.png + assets/weapons/hug.json. length: world px long in the match (57: about 1.5 × Rookie's kneeling body width); per gun (guns.<kind>_<tier>) length, hold [x, y], muzzle [x, y] (source px) background (key options over the shared ones; glow: a soft glow painted into the backdrop un-mixed from it) and despill (true: no key colour left anywhere, for art with none; {hueRange}: only on those hues) may be set; a gun with no picture is made from another tier's: from (the tier) + recolour (tools/import_guns.gd recolour(): saturation / value multipliers, hue shift in degrees, hueRange [lo, hi] limits it to those hues). See the tool's header and assets/README.md.

icons._doc: the equipment icons cut from the hug art (size / margin / tiltDeg: the held guns' art_source/weapons/guns_v1.json icons unless set here): <name with <tier>>.png in assets/icons/equipment/, one scale per group

bazooka_iron._doc: Rookie's bazooka (v2: one shape in four tiers, magenta backdrop: a long tube, a flared exhaust cone at the back, four bands, a box sight, the warhead out of the front): 57 world px long in every tier (aiming straight up its back end sits on his soles), held in the tube's middle, muzzle (all tiers) the warhead's tip; despill hueRange: the purple-tinted outline px next to the backdrop (up to hue 335: the dragon's dark crimson outline) turn dark, the art's reds are 345+

bazooka_basic._doc: the starter bazooka: the iron one desaturated, guns_v1.json recolours.basic (old basic.png = iron.png × that)

bazooka_dragon._doc: the length includes the dragon's head and the warhead in its mouth (its tube 3 % shorter than the other tiers'); hold: the tube's middle (iron's), not the gun's (the head sticks out in front); the muzzle: the warhead's tip in the mouth; the pockets of backdrop between the horns, under the fin and between the teeth keyed as holes

cannon_iron._doc: Tanko's cannon (v2: a short, very thick riveted cannon; gunmetal grey breech / bands, olive barrel), magenta backdrop: 52 world px long in every tier (about 25 thick; any longer and its back end sinks below his soles aiming straight up: his hug point is 119.43 pose px = 52.25 world px of half-length above them), held in the tube's middle; muzzle (all tiers): the centre of the bore inside the muzzle ring (the dark bore is part of the gun); despill hueRange: the purple-tinted outline px next to the backdrop

cannon_basic._doc: the starter cannon: the iron one desaturated, guns_v1.json recolours.basic (old cannon/basic.png = iron.png × that: fitted saturation ×0.553, value ×0.934)

cannon_dragon._doc: the length includes the head (the tube 1 % shorter than the other tiers'); muzzle: the middle of the open mouth between the teeth; small pockets of backdrop between the teeth and round the horns keyed as holes; the fire in the mouth is solid art inside the outline (no glow to un-mix); the small ember sparks floating right of the mouth are detached pieces, dropped by clean()

seed_launcher_iron._doc: Flora's seed launcher (grey back cap, olive tube, leaf sight, green seed pod), magenta backdrop: 45 world px long in every tier (any longer and its back end sinks below her soles aiming straight up: her hug point is 104.96 scene px = 45.9 world px of tube high), held in the tube's middle; muzzle (all tiers): the middle of what sits in the bore (pod / crystal / seed); despill hueRange: the purple-tinted outline px next to the backdrop turn black, the art has no purple (the steel cap's pink is hue 335+)

seed_launcher_basic._doc: the starter seed launcher: the iron one desaturated, guns_v1.json recolours.basic (old seed_launcher/basic.png = iron.png × that: fitted saturation ×0.552, value ×0.936)

seed_launcher_mithril._doc: the crystal's soft glow painted into the magenta: un-mixed into a clean cyan glow (key_background glow), measured without it, faded out over the pad

seed_launcher_dragon._doc: the length includes the head (the tube 1 % shorter than the other tiers'); muzzle: the fiery seed in the open mouth; small pockets of backdrop between the horn and the tube and between the teeth keyed as holes; the seed's glow un-mixed into a clean yellow-orange one

shock_rifle_iron._doc: Spark's shock rifle (gunmetal tube, blue wave window, copper coils, forked prongs, an orb between them): 55 world px long in every tier (his hug point is 128.05 scene px = 56.0 world px of tube high: any longer and the back end sinks below his soles aiming straight up), held in the tube's middle; muzzle (all tiers): the orb's centre; the open fork between the prongs is backdrop reached from the border (keyed); the orb's glow un-mixed into a clean one of its colour (iron cyan-blue, steel violet, mithril white-cyan), measured without it; despill hueRange: the green-tinted outline / engraving px only (the cyan wave and glow, the gold kept)

shock_rifle_basic._doc: the starter shock rifle: the iron one desaturated, guns_v1.json recolours.basic (old shock_rifle/basic.png = iron.png × that: fitted saturation ×0.556, value ×0.935)

shock_rifle_dragon._doc: the length includes the dragon's head; muzzle: the orange lightning orb in the open mouth (the mouth is backdrop reached from the border); the thin lightning lines round the orb lie inside the mouth and key cleanly: kept; a small pocket of backdrop between the horn and the head keyed as a hole; no green left (the dragon has no green); the orb's glow un-mixed into a clean orange one

water_gun_iron._doc: Tide's water gun (v1: one shape in four tiers, green backdrop: a chunky tube with a glass water chamber on top, a pump slider in the middle, a ribbed hose elbow at the back end, a wide flared nozzle in front; iron grey with teal bands): 46 world px long in every tier (her hug point is 56.7 ready-pose px above her soles: any longer and its back end sinks below them aiming straight up; the chunky chamber makes it look bigger than its length), held at the middle of its length on the tube's upper part (hold y 430: the fists on top of the tube, so the glass chamber stays under her chin, not over her face); muzzle (iron / steel / mithril): the right end at the nozzle's middle height (the default); despill hueRange: the green-tinted outline px next to the backdrop only (the teal bands, hue 175+, kept); the AI sparkle bottom right is a detached piece (dropped)

water_gun_basic._doc: the starter water gun: the iron one desaturated, like the other guns' basic tier

water_gun_dragon._doc: the length includes the dragon's head and the water orb in its mouth (a darker green backdrop: the corners' colour is the key); muzzle: the orb's centre; the pockets of backdrop between the teeth and round the horns keyed as holes; the orb's glow un-mixed into a clean cyan one
